item.title: Version 1.0.0
item.description:
Added

  • ADSwift 1.0 is here. The first public launch build is ready for indie app developers managing Apple Search Ads.
  • New market coverage map. See where your campaigns are active across Apple Ads-supported countries and regions.
  • Untapped market discovery. Spot supported countries where you are not running campaigns yet, grouped by region and opportunity tier.
  • Richer country insights. Country popovers now show clearer market context and performance signals.
  • Yearly and lifetime plans. Choose the plan that fits how you want to use ADSwift.

Changed

  • Cleaner launch offer experience. Pricing, plan labels, and checkout buttons are clearer and easier to scan.
  • Faster first screen. ADSwift does less heavy background syncing during launch, so the main dashboard feels more responsive.
  • More stable table updates. Campaign, ad group, keyword, and search-term tables now stay steadier while filters, dates, and revenue data refresh.
  • Cleaner revenue loading. RevenueCat data loads in a calmer, more predictable way across the app.

Fixed

  • More reliable license activation. ADSwift now handles edge cases from the license service more gracefully and shows clearer errors when activation needs attention.
  • More reliable RevenueCat reconnects. Project and app loading now handles refresh timing better, reducing stale or confusing states.
  • More accurate loading indicators. Old background requests no longer interfere with newer refreshes.
  • Revenue and profit summaries stay better aligned with the table you are currently viewing.
